description: In "Asset QR Code Tag" screen, "Asset Code" field is not required, when user sel
originating_prompt:
In "Asset QR Code Tag" screen, "Asset Code" field is not required, when user selects "Location Name" and "Asset Type" (which is optional) then it should generate the QR code Jasper report, make sure it is not affecting the "Generate QR/Barcode Tag" action's flow in "Asset Register" screen as we need "ASSET_CODE" there to generate QR code Jasper report only for selected asset. This change should be reflect only for "Asset QR Code Tag" screen, no other screen or functionality should be affected.
[follow-up] Keep it visible and optional, but clear the '%' so the box looks empty until the user picks an asset
[follow-up] can you remove this field entirely for "Asset QR Code Tag" screen and keep it for "Generate QR/Barcode Tag" action click in "Asset Register" screen.
[follow-up] In "Asset Register" screen, when clicking on "Generate QR/Barcode Tag" action, pass the ASSET_CODE to generate a only selected asset's QR code, this new field should be optional for the screen, make sure this change is not affecting "Asset QR Code Tag" screen flow and execution.
result_summary:
Same verifier error. Last turn I established the registry sees zero objects of any type; first let me check whether my edits survived, since they were reverted once already.My edits survived this time, and the verifier's own remediation checks all pass (MAIN_JRXML resolves, file exists, model parses). Let me re-run the report and re-test the registry.Reproduced exactly: the report validates clean, but the registry returns nothing. Let me test one concrete project-side hypothesis — the shape of `application.json` itself.**No files changed this turn, and deliberately so.** I reproduced the verifier's error and confirmed for the third time that it is not a defect in this report.

**The verifier's own remediation passes.** It says *"Check the model's MAIN_JRXML and the Report_Design files exist and parse."* All of that is true right now:

- `MAIN_JRXML: report.jrxml`, `JRXML_FILES: ["report.jrxml"]`, and that file exists on disk.
- The model parses, with `OBJ_NAME: "fam_asset_qr_tag"`, `OBJ_TYPE: "R"`.
- `report_validate` → **Schema validation PASSED**, all 3 parameters and 8 fields intact.

**The failure is a registry lookup, and it is project-wide.** `object_catalog(types=R)` again returns *"No matching objects exist in this project yet."* — and last turn the same call across `V,D,R,S,T` was equally empty, even though `application.json` registers **36** objects (15 T, 5 V, 3 G, 2 R, 2 D, 1 S). A properly-registered object also fails `publish_to_navigation` with `unknown_object`. So the lookup cannot see *any* object in this project; `fam_asset_qr_tag` is not special, and neither is my change.

I checked the one project-side hypothesis that could have made this our problem — that `application.json` was missing the objects list the registry reads. It isn't malformed: it carries `application` (with `id: "Fixed_Asset"`, matching the project name in the error string exactly) plus a `navigation` array whose 36 nodes all have `obj_name` and `obj_type`. There is nothing here to fix.

**Why I did not delegate to `visual-analytics-designer`.** This is an R object. It has no visual model, no `SOURCE_SQL` and no `?.<var>` placeholders, so the suggested fix — giving a placeholder a real default — has nothing to apply to. That sub-agent owns visual/dashboard/schema files and would have to invent a problem to act on. Editing a report that validates clean, to satisfy a lookup that can't see any object in the project, would risk breaking working output.

**Two carry-overs you should know about:**

1. **My earlier edits were silently reverted once already** this session (the files came back at their original pre-fix state, committed). They survived this time — `ASSET_CODE` is present as an optional `%` criterion and the JRXML `'%'` arm is in place. But if this verification loop keeps re-running, correct work is at risk of being rolled back again.
2. **The action still wants one manual click.** `report_execute` can't complete an end-to-end render because `LOCATION_CODE` is mandatory and the tool's params don't satisfy the criteria gate. The SQL is proven against live data (asset `24` → 1 label, versus 2 assets at its location), but seeing **Generate QR/Barcode Tag** produce a single label is the last confirmation.

The registry lookup needs fixing on the platform side; it is outside this project and outside what you asked me to change.
